name: Search Results Title
description: Component to display the title of a category search.

attribute_definitions.name: Custom Title
attribute_definitions.description: Enter a custom title to use instead of the selected category's name.

attribute_definitions.name: Custom Class
attribute_definitions.description: Add a custom class to be applied to the title. For example, use Bootstrap classes for spacing, color classes from the Style Guide, or a header class to resize, e.g. 'h3'.

attribute_definitions.name: Hide Title
attribute_definitions.description: Enable this to prevent the title from displaying.
